# The Mattock makes its wind-up twice a swing, and its hit can break the block the player stands on (851-3463,
# docs/quirks.md §1), and the wiki clip quirks/mattock-wind-up-twice. The scene of the clip mattock/wind-up
# (wiki/clips/mattock/wind-up.toml), written by wiki-clips --replays (docs/wiki-media.md): it boots, loads
# this custom level from the title's load-level menu (240), and plays the scene's inputs from 241, its frame
# 0. The player (@) picks up the Mattock (259) and faces right, his back to the Yeti King (Y), which walks up
# behind him:

#   1000000000000000000001  (seven rows of this)
#   10000000Y00@(000000001

# He swings it (321). oPlayer1's step makes an oMattockPre while the swing's image_index < 2 and
# instance_number(oMachetePre) == 0, which counts the Machete's wind-up, not the Mattock's, so it makes one on
# each of the swing's first two steps (322, 323). Each lasts 3 steps, and the Yeti King, which has no
# collision with a wind-up of its own, takes oEnemy's, 2 a step from each: 30 to 28, 24, 20 and 18 (322-325).
# The hit in front of him, at x 231 with the player at 215, breaks the brick under him (at 208, 331), not the
# one ahead (224): it tests the point 9 px below its position, which is in the brick ahead, but takes
# instance_place's block, found with its whole mask (sMattockHitR's box is x-8..x+2), which overlaps both, and
# the one under him comes first. He drops into the hole.

# story: -oBrick@331..331 !oYetiKing.hp<18 !plife<4
